name: tabocalypse-reaper
description: Firefox extension that ends tab chaos: groups tabs by host → cluster (GitHub/AWS aware), shows favicons, filters, and reaps whole groups with a confirm guard.

scripts.prepare: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && npm run copy:assets
scripts.build: npm run prepare && web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run prepare && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.verify:popup: npm run prepare && node scripts/build-popup-harness.mjs && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run prepare && npm-run-all --parallel watch:ts watch:assets web-ext:run

author: Kim Dowling
